authorization: ORDEM018 F1(b), unidade delegada explicitamente: reprodução histórica independente T/F4; demais famílias/evidências após verificação.
beta_rule: ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018 * sqrt(e) runtime, not fitted in TGL model
prior: Uniform declared broad limits; likelihood zero outside actual CAMB support. No evidence or prior renormalization in this unit.

likelihood.cc: 32point diagonal sigma^2; historical full systematic covariance absent; F7 not substituted

independence: New NumPy/SciPy implementation; no imports/execution of original motor, backups, um.py or original fitting helpers; frozen public numerical table reused as input.

numerics.distance: independent Gauss-Legendre64 with128 convergence at archived and fitted points; original Simpson20001 not silently represented as same algorithm
numerics.table: independent 6node degree5 separable Lagrange interpolation with original support mask
numerics.optimization: TRF least_squares, historical scaled coordinates and central Jacobian h=.001, tolerances1e-12, max_nfev200; LCDM first, TGL/free start from LCDM
numerics.uncertainty: inverse JtJ scaled to physical units, no reduced-chi2 rescaling

tolerance_status: Engineering reproduction thresholds fixed before first numerical run, not scientific decision thresholds; pre-read historic target values declared.

resources.peak_working_set_reporting: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo; process total includes Python libraries

stop_rule: Any hash error, source support excursion, holdout/fixed-point divergence, optimizer failure or threshold mismatch -> preserve local failure output and STOP before extending batch.
rollback: no original write; new outputs refuse overwrite
